## Technical Summary

* **Objective:** Synthesize individual cartographic components into a publication-ready atlas sheet. The top row forms a three-tier geographic zoom sequence (Western US &rarr; California &rarr; Bight of California), anchored below by the campus base map (Map 6).
* **Key Packages:** `magick`
* **Inputs:**
  * `images/map3.png` (900 x 1200 px)
  * `images/map4.png` (900 x 1200 px)
  * `images/map5.png` (1200 x 900 px)
  * `images/map6.1.png` (3600 x 1200 px)
* **Outputs:**
  * Top tryptic row: `final_output/map7_row_1.png`
  * Complete atlas sheet: `final_output/map_07.png`
